bounds.domain: One runtime, one eager service, two turns, two stop callers and at most two stop attempts. The model retains await boundaries in initialization, turn admission and shutdown.
bounds.limitations: The real runtime suite checks failed initialization, cancellation of a queued turn and service visibility after shutdown. The full best-effort and strict stop interleavings are formal in this bound.

stateRepresentation: The source variables form one typed record. Every action updates that record atomically and retains all other fields.

assumptions: Checked formula in RuntimeLifecycle: DeadlockFree = always(enabled(nextStep))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
Checked formula in RuntimeLifecycle: NoAdmissionAfterClose = always(s.closed.implies(next(s.queue).length() <= s.queue.length()).orKeep(s))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
Checked formula in RuntimeLifecycle: StopperReturns = Fairness.implies(Stoppers.forall(caller => Set("be", "drain", "awaitStrict").contains(s.spc.get(caller)).leadsTo(s.spc.get(caller) == "done")))
